mapper.sql: id, category_name, category_notes, icon, sort, status, created_by, creation_date, modify_by, modify_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM house_category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC

SELECT c.id, c.category_name, c.category_notes, c.icon, c.sort, c.status, c.created_by, c.creation_date, c.modify_by, c.modify_date, COUNT(h.id) AS house_count FROM house_category c LEFT JOIN house h ON c.id = h.category_id AND h.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, c.category_notes, c.icon, c.sort, c.status, c.created_by, c.creation_date, c.modify_by, c.modify_date ORDER BY c.sort ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO house_category (category_name, category_notes, icon, sort, status, created_by, creation_date) VALUES (#{categoryName}, #{categoryNotes}, #{icon}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
